final_script:
User story: "As a customer on https://www.saucedemo.com, I want to sort products by price so that I can find the cheapest item first. Acceptance criteria: after logging in with 'standard_user' / 'secret_sauce', selecting the option with value 'lohi' in the sort dropdown [data-test="product-sort-container"] reorders the list so that the numeric values of the '.inventory_item_price' elements appear in ascending order."
Category: search_filter
Complexity: medium
